name: manage_accounts
description: Manage Google Workspace account lifecycle: list, authenticate, check status, refresh credentials, update scopes, or remove accounts.

operation.description: list: show all accounts | authenticate: add new account (opens browser) | remove: delete account and credentials | status: check token validity and scopes | refresh: renew credentials | scopes: re-auth with different services | capabilities: show available services, safety policies, and workspace status

email.description: Required for remove, status, refresh, scopes

services.description: For scopes — comma-separated service names (e.g. gmail,drive,calendar,sheets)
